title: 「The trouble ／ problem ／ issue with ... is that ...」指出問題所在
titleZh: 「The trouble ／ problem ／ issue with ... is that ...」指出問題所在
titleEn: Using “The trouble / problem / issue with ... is that ...”

source.file: Sentence Structure 185 -「The trouble _ problem _ issue with ... is that ...」指出問題所在.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: The trouble / problem / issue with + noun / noun phrase / V-ing + is / was that + complete clause

formulas.formula: The trouble / problem / issue with + noun / noun phrase / V-ing + is / was that + complete clause

example: The trouble with simple slogans is that they hide complex realities.
exampleZh: 簡單口號的問題在於，它們掩蓋了複雜的現實。

examples.en: The trouble with simple slogans is that they hide complex realities.
examples.zh: 簡單口號的問題在於，它們掩蓋了複雜的現實。
examples.highlight: The trouble with simple slogans is that they hide complex realities.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：The trouble / problem / issue with + noun / noun phrase / V-ing + is / was that + complete clause。

rules.zh: with 後面接名詞、名詞詞組或 -ing 形式 名詞或名詞詞組： （這個計劃的問題在於，它的成本太高。） 動名詞： （不停工作、不作休息的問題在於，你會感到疲倦。） with 後面不能直接放一個完整句子。
rules.en: Use a noun, noun phrase or -ing form after with. Noun or noun phrase: The problem with this plan is that it costs too much. Gerund: The problem with working without a break is that you become tired. Do not put a complete clause directly after with. Incorrect: The problem with people work too long is that they become tired. Correct: The problem with people working too long is that they become tired.
examples: The problem with this plan is that it costs too much.
The problem with working without a break is that you become tired.
Incorrect: The problem with people work too long is that they become tired.
Correct: The problem with people working too long is that they become tired.

rules.zh: that 後面必須是完整句子 that 後面通常要有主語和動詞。 ● Subject 主語：two lessons ● Verb 動詞：happen
rules.en: Use a complete clause after that. The clause normally needs a subject and a verb. In “The issue with the timetable is that two lessons happen at the same time”, two lessons is the subject and happen is the verb.
examples: The issue with the timetable is that two lessons happen at the same time.

rules.zh: 使用 is 還是 was 使用 is 表達現在、一般情況或仍然存在的問題。 使用 was 表達過去某個情況中的問題。
rules.en: Choose is or was according to time. Use is for a present or general situation, or for a problem that still exists: The problem with the machine is that it makes too much noise. Use was for a problem in a past situation: The problem with the old machine was that it made too much noise.
examples: The problem with the machine is that it makes too much noise.
The problem with the old machine was that it made too much noise.

rules.zh: trouble、problem 和 issue 的分別 常用來指出最令人困擾的實際困難，語氣自然，在日常說話中很常見。 意思最普遍、最中性，適合日常說話、作文、討論和報告。 語氣通常較溫和或較正式，常用於學校、工作、制度或技術討論。 三者的意思有時可以重疊。本練習的答案會根據原句用詞提供一個最合適的示範答案。
rules.en: Distinguish trouble, problem and issue. The trouble with ... often identifies the most troublesome practical difficulty and sounds natural in everyday speech: The trouble with this bag is that it is difficult to carry. The problem with ... is the broadest and most neutral choice for conversation, essays, discussions and reports: The problem with the plan is that it costs too much. The issue with ... is usually milder or more formal and is common in school, workplace, institutional and technical discussions: The issue with the system is that it sometimes loses information. Their meanings can overlap, so the model answers choose the most suitable word for each prompt.
examples: The trouble with ...
The trouble with this bag is that it is difficult to carry.
The problem with ...
The problem with the plan is that it costs too much.
The issue with ...
The issue with the system is that it sometimes loses information.

rules.zh: 進階對比形式 當你想糾正別人對問題的誤解時，可以使用： （這篇文章的問題不在於它太長，而在於它的論點不清楚。）
rules.en: Use the advanced contrast form when correcting a misunderstanding about the problem: The problem with + noun + is not that + clause, but that + clause. Example: The problem with the article is not that it is long, but that its argument is unclear.
examples: The problem with + noun + is not that + clause, but that + clause.
The problem with the article is not that it is long, but that its argument is unclear.

rules.zh: the problem with 和 the problem of 並不完全相同 指出 X 本身有甚麼缺點或困難。 （這個計劃的問題在於，它的成本太高。） 通常把 X 當作一個需要處理的廣泛問題或社會議題。 （政府必須處理空氣污染問題。）
rules.en: The problem with and the problem of are not identical. The problem with X identifies a defect or difficulty in X itself: The problem with the plan is that it is too expensive. The problem of X usually presents X as a broad problem or social issue that needs to be addressed: Governments must address the problem of air pollution.
examples: the problem with X
The problem with the plan is that it is too expensive.
the problem of X
Governments must address the problem of air pollution.

rules.zh: 不要與 have trouble + -ing 混淆 （我難以理解這條問題。） 這裏的 have trouble + -ing 表示「做某事有困難」，不是本課所學的句型。
rules.en: Do not confuse this structure with have trouble + -ing. In “I have trouble understanding this question”, have trouble + -ing means that someone finds an action difficult; it is not the target structure in this lesson.
examples: I have trouble understanding this question.

benefits.zh: 清楚指出問題究竟在哪裏 你不只是籠統地說某件事「不好」，而是能清楚說明它的具體缺點。 （時間表很差。） （時間表的問題在於，兩堂課在同一時間進行。）
benefits.en: It identifies exactly where the problem lies. Instead of saying vaguely that something is “bad”, you can state its specific weakness. Less clear: The timetable is bad. Clearer: The problem with the timetable is that two lessons take place at the same time.

benefits.zh: 把事物和問題原因連接起來 這個句型先提出要討論的事物，再用 that 說明問題，因此讀者很容易掌握兩者的關係。 （網站的問題在於，文字很難閱讀。）
benefits.en: It connects a thing with the cause of its problem. The structure first introduces the thing being discussed and then uses that to explain the problem, making the relationship easy to follow. Example: The issue with the website is that the text is difficult to read.

benefits.zh: 幫助你作出有理據的評價 在作文、討論、會議或簡報中，只說一個計劃「不好」並不足夠。這個句型能幫助你進一步解釋理 由。 （建議書的問題在於，它沒有解釋項目將如何獲得資金。）
benefits.en: It helps you make a reasoned evaluation. In an essay, discussion, meeting or presentation, merely calling a plan “bad” is not enough; this structure helps you explain why. Example: The problem with the proposal is that it does not explain how the project will be funded.

benefits.zh: 令批評較客觀，減少針對個人的感覺 你可以把焦點放在制度、做法或安排上，而不是直接責怪某個人。 （你把會議安排得很差。） （會議時間的問題在於，幾名團隊成員都未能出席。）
benefits.en: It makes criticism more objective and less personal by focusing on a system, practice or arrangement instead of directly blaming someone. Direct and personal: You planned the meeting badly. More objective: The issue with the meeting time is that several team members are unavailable.

benefits.zh: 讓你按照情況調整語氣 你可以使用 trouble 表達實際困難，使用 problem 作一般評論，或使用較溫和、正式的 issue 因此，這個句型適合用於： ● 日常對話； ● 英文作文； ● 問題分析； ● 工作會議； ● 報告及簡報； ● 產品或服務評價。
benefits.en: It lets you adjust the tone to the situation. Use trouble for a practical difficulty, problem for a general criticism, or the milder, more formal issue. This makes the structure suitable for daily conversation, essays, problem analysis, workplace meetings, reports, presentations, and evaluations of products or services.
